models.name: Model A: Steady RANS hemolysis mapper
models.what_it_computes: Steady-state RANS (k–ω SST) with Newtonian viscosity; computes pressure–flow performance, scalar shear stress fields, and pathline-based power-law hemolysis estimates traced on steady streamlines.

models.name: Model B: Transient DES with tracer exposure
models.what_it_computes: Hybrid RANS–LES (DES) with Carreau–Yasuda rheology; computes time-resolved shear rate and cumulative shear exposure (CSE) for Lagrangian virtual erythrocyte tracers, yielding exposure–threshold distributions.

models.name: Model C: Eulerian damage-transport
models.what_it_computes: Single-phase CFD coupled to an Eulerian transport equation for a damage scalar with shear- and time-dependent source terms; computes outlet-averaged damage index as a surrogate for normalized hemolysis.

mechanisms.name: Tip-clearance viscous shear
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Tight blade–shroud gaps concentrate shear and are a recurrent origin of acute red cell damage in rotary blood pumps.

mechanisms.name: Recirculation-driven exposure
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Zones of recirculation in the back-shroud gap and volute extend residence time, elevating cumulative sublethal damage that can progress to hemolysis.

mechanisms.name: Transient extensional/turbulent events
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Rapid strain-rate spikes near the blade leading edge and volute tongue impose short, intense loading that can trigger burst injury in susceptible cells.

deviation.detail: All credibility factors are scored per model–mechanism pair on a 0–4 Assurance Index (0 none, 1 minimal, 2 partial, 3 substantial, 4 complete), and results are summarized using this numeric scale.

expected_decision.outcome_source: The results support design acceptability decisions for the specified quadrant when using Model B for transient exposure and either Model A or B for gap shear, with Model C as a conservative screen for recirculation risk.

models: Model B (Transient DES with tracer exposure)
datasets: blood-loop hemolysis tests at four operating points within the COU
time-resolved PIV in a geometrically identical, refractive-index-matched transparent surrogate model
acceptance_criteria: an NIH not exceeding 0.02 g/100 L at 120 min under the operating quadrant
a fraction of cells above the transient threshold below 0.5%
